_meta.description: Slice 02 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain. The bespoke top-level Purchase Order create-form + detail PAGES and their Inkoop/PurchaseOrders menu entry were REMOVED: purchase orders are now composed onto the unified Order workspace (order-workspace.json), so the standalone PurchaseOrderForm/PurchaseOrderDetail nav surfaces are superseded. The PurchaseOrder SCHEMA and its lifecycle stay intact — only the folded PAGE + MENU definitions were retired. Related artefacts (three-way matching index in slice 06, vendor performance in slice 10) remain their own pages.
